AWPTCM-T33371.objective:
• When two-step authentication is enabled with 802.1X as the first method and WEB as the second method, a correct 802.1X authentication at the first step transitions the supplicant to the "Connecting" state awaiting the second-step WEB authentication.
  • Invalid 802.1X credentials at the first step place the supplicant in the HELD state for the duration of the quiet-period.
  • Invalid WEB credentials within the max-auth-fail limit at the second step place the supplicant in the "Reauthenticating" state, allowing further attempts.
  • Invalid WEB credentials at the max-auth-fail count at the second step place the supplicant in the HELD state for the quiet-period.
  • Successful completion of the second-step WEB authentication results in the supplicant reaching the Authenticated state.
  • Attempting WEB authentication at the first step (before 802.1X success) shows a "please retry later" message and is blocked.
  • Correct log messages are generated at the appropriate times for success and failure of each step (first 802.1X and second WEB).
  • The "auth two-step enable" command is accepted, appears in running-config, persists after save and reboot, and can be disabled with the "no" form.
  • The "show auth two-step supplicant" (and brief) commands accurately report two-step information including firstMethod (802.1x), secondMethod (web), per-supplicant status for each step, and counts.
  • The maximum number of supplicants supported for two-step auth (1st 802.1X / 2nd WEB) is correctly enforced.
  • RADIUS integration functions correctly for two-step authentication (VLAN ID included in requests at each step).

steps.description: Note: Related ART Tests linked in Traceability. Primary coverage from TestLink two-step 802.1x/WEB family (AWP-14784 primary + AWP-14773 enable, AWP-14774 show, AWP-14776/14779 802.1x logs, AWP-14880 max for 802/WEB, AWP-15819 RADIUS 2-step). ART coverage: 1348.1001.20 (802.1x auth), 1348.1001.11 (config), 1348.3001.* (web auth success/fail/guest-vlan), 6201.1033.* (two-step variants + web fail checks).
Enable two-step authentication (auth two-step enable) together with 802.1X and WEB auth. Verify the enable command and "no" form work, persist after reboot, and appear correctly in running-config.

Connect a supplicant. Perform Two-Step with 1st step 802.1X (correct credentials) followed by 2nd step WEB (correct). Verify transition through Connecting to final Authenticated. Confirm "show auth two-step supplicant" reports firstMethod=802.1x, secondMethod=web, and step statuses.
Test failure paths: invalid 802.1X at 1st (expect HELD), correct 802.1X then invalid WEB within max-auth-fail (Reauthenticating), then at max (HELD). Verify logs for 802.1X as first step.
Attempt to access the WEB auth page at the 1st step (before successful 802.1X). Verify it is blocked with "please retry later" message.
Verify correct success and failure log messages are produced for each step (802.1X first and WEB second).
Test the supported maximum number of supplicants for this two-step combination (1st 802.1X / 2nd WEB). Confirm enforcement.
Verify RADIUS behavior in two-step: VLAN ID is included in RADIUS-Request packets for each authentication step.
